card.name: The digit 1 or 2 starting a quantity
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (sometimes 2) that begins a number before a unit, such as drinks, cups, minutes, hours, inches or tablespoons. It also fires on the first digit of numbers like 120 or 10%.

modes.label: Leading digit of an amount
modes.description: A 1 or 2 opens an amount of food, drink or time, often followed by a unit.

modes.label: First digit of a longer number
modes.description: A 1 or 2 begins a multi-digit figure such as 120 minutes or 10%, and the number may continue after it.
